mandatory_explanations.text: The Geʿez expression is direction of morning or sunrise, hence east; this note applies to east rather than another place.
The term rendered wilderness can also mean desert or barren region.
Or I drew near to this mountain on the east; the placement of the directional phrase is not certain.

mandatory_explanations.text: The printed Charles 1906 Geʿez has †ኵነኔ, judgment, marked corrupt; the printed Greek parallel likewise has κρίσεως. Charles proposes fragrant in printed page 69 notes 14 and 27. That is an editorial conjecture, not the reading printed in either main text. Judgment remains semantically difficult.

The Geʿez †ፈድፋደ is marked corrupt. Giving off follows the editor’s repair πνέοντα in printed page 69 note 28, not the printed Greek main-text πιέοντα or an unproblematic Geʿez reading. The following bracketed [ቈስቍስ፡] is untranslated: printed note 29 calls it unintelligible and an intrusion if the Greek is right, while considering a corrupt tree name.

Only the final parenthesized comparison noun (ከርካዕ።) is editor-supplied in the Geʿez with assistance from the Greek; the preceding resemblance words are printed without parentheses. Charles 1906 printed page 69 notes 18 and 29 and page 70 note 2 explain the supply. Greek καρύαις means nut-bearing trees of several kinds; almond is one proposed identification, not a proven species or independently attested Ethiopic manuscript clause.

The bracketed intrusion remains in source and is explicitly untranslated; the final nut noun alone is parenthesized and editor supplied, whereas the preceding resemblance verb is printed unparenthesized. However, retained English their trees is not justified by selectedGeʽezወዕፀወሂ. Fresh actual Dillmanncolumn2 entryሂ describes an adverbial suffix with etiam/quoque/emphatic uses, not plural possessive. The Greek explicitly has τὰ δένδρα αὐτῶν, but no adopted possessive control or explanation is recorded; the existing final-noun-only supply record cannot silently stretch to cover it. Whole exact29:2 payload therefore remains unapproved pending a source-faithful author correction or a genuinely justified separately recorded adoption.
